newsitem.title: INDIA: Arafat says Israel declares war on peace process.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Israel declares war on peace process.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said on Monday that Israel had declared "war against the peace process" in the Middle East and violated written agreements with the Palestinians.
"The Israeli government is going through a war of aggression against our people," Arafat told a meeting of foreign ministers of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) in the Indian capital.

"It is regrettable that the Israeli government should take advantage of the United States veto twice in 10 days to continue on the path of aggression and challenge international legitimacy," Arafat said. "It is a declaration of war against the peace process."
U.S. vetoes on March 7 and March 21 prevented action by the U.N. Security Council on Israel's plan to build 6,500 homes for Jews on land captured during the 1967 Middle East war.
Ties between the Palestinians and Israelis plunged into crisis after the Israeli government broke ground on the settlement.

"The Israeli government is constantly violating promises of the agreements signed between us. The annexation of land is going on," Arafat said. "Israel is striving to establish relations with Arab nations, non-aligned countries and the entire world at our expense, at the expense of the Palestinian people."
